scripts.build: npm run build -w @siwc/local && npm run build -w @siwc/react && npm run build -w @siwc/paste-perfect && npm run build -w @siwc/component-gallery
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start -w @siwc/paste-perfect
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @siwc/local && npm run build -w @siwc/react && npm run dev:web -w @siwc/paste-perfect
scripts.dev:gallery: npm run build -w @siwc/react && npm run dev -w @siwc/component-gallery
scripts.test: npm run build -w @siwc/local && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/local/test/*.test.mjs examples/paste-perfect/test/*.test.mjs
